increment_paragraph: **GENERATED-ROOTS** (refactoring round 1, pluggable-cards seams C and D; [report](../../reports/generated-roots/README.md)). The four files every implementation card edited are now generated. `scripts/gen_lean_roots.py` writes `proof/QCore.lean` (every module under `proof/QCore/`, sorted; import order fixes no build order or declaration, so there is no order file) and `proof/AuditAll.lean`; the environment importing the generated root has the byte-identical constant list of the base root (102,367 audited `QCore` constants, 310,354 in all), and `check_lean_audits.py` still discovers 370 audits. Each of the 210 router-indexed constraints, plus gateway's `11-series` lead-in, is one `docs/agents/rules/<id>.md` carrying its text byte for byte; `scripts/gen_rule_docs.py` regenerates the topic pages' constraint sections and the router's stable index (now in natural order) with every anchor and preserved marker kept and every repository constraint link resolving (603 at base, 623 with the rule files' own). `scripts/tests/test_generated_roots.py` fails a hand edit. No analyzer, contract, theorem or verdict change.

ledger.title: Rule amendments still live outside their rule files
ledger.text: After GENERATED-ROOTS each router-indexed constraint is one docs/agents/rules/<id>.md, but amendment sections that qualify a rule remain hand-edited topic-page text outside the generated section: buffers-records.md and source-routes.md (constraint-15k-amendments, constraint-14-amendments and post-migration sections), effects.md's amendment to 15m, diagnostics.md's namespace and amendment sections, providers.md's CONTRACT-INHERIT amendment, and the trailing sections of concurrency.md, evidence.md, source-identity.md and validation.md. DISCHARGE: each is folded into its rule file or registered as its own rule, so the rule file is the rule's whole authority.
